dedupe_keys.name: power lines uav images three raw drone image sets for power line vegetation encroachment detection czech technical university in prague

description: Power Lines UAV Images is a set of three Harvard Dataverse deposits by Radek Ježek of the Faculty of Information Technology at the Czech Technical University in Prague. Each is described as an example dataset of drone images for power line vegetation encroachment detection, with the GPS position of each image in its EXIF metadata. Dataset 1 holds 187 images, Dataset 2 holds 135 and Dataset 3 holds 196, all as Sony ARW raw files; Dataset 1 alone is about 16 GB. The terms of use state CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and the images are free to download. All three were published in March 2022 and have not been updated since; the related publication is listed as to be announced. Coverage is the flight sites of the surveys, which the pages do not name. Caveats: there are no labels, annotations or line geometries on the pages, the raw format needs conversion, and commercial use is barred. Simulation uses are imagery for training or testing vegetation clearance detection that feeds line exposure to tree fall in storms and to vegetation contact ignition. Related records: data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm is another asset dataset; no other energy record here holds line inspection imagery.
